gloss: water current; stream; flow of water

definitions.gloss: water current; stream; flow of water
definitions.explanation: The movement or flow of water in a river, ocean, pipe, or other channel.

examples.japanese: {水流|すいりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧。
⟦{大雨|おおあめ}→大雨：03015_ooame⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{川|かわ}→川：02186_kawa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{水流|すいりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しく→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The river current became fierce due to heavy rain.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧{水流|すいりゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}した→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧⟦{発電|はつでん}→発電：04312_hatsuden⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われている→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: In this region, power generation using underground water currents is being carried out.

notes:
A compound of {水|すい} (water) and {流|りゅう} (flow, current). Refers to the physical movement of water, whether in natural settings (rivers, oceans) or artificial ones (pipes, channels).

USAGE:
- Described with ⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧/⟦{遅|おそ}い→遅い：00533_osoi⟧ (fast/slow) or ⟦{強|つよ}い→強い：00820_tsuyoi⟧/⟦{弱|よわ}い→弱い：00825_yowai⟧ (strong/weak)
- Common in geography, weather reports, and outdoor safety contexts
- Used in both scientific and everyday settings

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {水流|すいりゅう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{速|はや}い→速い：00514_hayai⟧: the current is fast
- {水流|すいりゅう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{流|なが}される→流す：01968_nagasu⟧: to be carried away by the current
- ⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧{水流|すいりゅう}: fierce current
- ⟦{地下|ちか}→地下：03429_chika⟧{水流|すいりゅう}: underground water current
- {水流|すいりゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{利用|りよう}する→利用する：21735_riyousuru⟧: to utilize water flow

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{流|なが}れ→流れ：03504_nagare⟧: flow, current — the everyday word for any kind of flow (water, air, traffic, time)
- ⟦{潮流|ちょうりゅう}→潮流：13417_chouryuu⟧: tidal current, ocean current — specifically ocean currents; also used figuratively for trends
- ⟦{河川|かせん}→河川：13276_kasen⟧: river — the body of water itself rather than the movement of water within it
